name: Maps
description: A map of every place your space has: the places you have saved and the items other modules put somewhere. Pick a spot to save a new place.
author: Coffee Pub

permissions.label: See the map and its places
Save places from the map and put items on it

settings.label: Map files
settings.help: The PMTiles files the map is drawn from, all together. With environments, the files are the host's and only a host admin adds or cuts them (the host console); on a single server they are in this module's map-tiles folder in the data folder, ticked here.

settings.label: World file, for cutting a region
settings.help: A world PMTiles file to cut a region from with "Add a region". The server reads only the part it cuts, over https range requests, never the whole file. Protomaps publishes a daily build at https://build.protomaps.com/YYYYMMDD.pmtiles, where YYYYMMDD is the build's date (https://build.protomaps.com/20260924.pmtiles, say); any recent date works, or point this at your own stable copy. Left empty, cutting a region is off. With environments this is the host's, on the host console.

settings.label: Search on the map
settings.help: The field at the bottom of the map searches through whichever module offers a place search (the Places module does), and that module's own configuration is where the search is chosen and switched on; Maps has no search of its own. Until one is chosen there, the field still takes pasted coordinates or a map link.
